definition: Alternative electricity supply that maintains operations when the primary supply becomes unavailable. Includes standby generators, UPS, battery reserves and independent backup feeds. Excludes primary electricity supply and storage without an explicit outage-continuity function. Battery reserves may qualify at solar-powered sites when outage autonomy is stated. Renewable backup may also qualify as renewable_energy when the renewable source is explicit. Data backup is disaster_recovery; alternative communications paths are network_redundancy.
